title: Get the app
intro: Karins jigsaw works in any browser. You can also have it as an app on your phone, tablet or computer.
alreadyInApp: You are already using the app.
notReady: This download is not ready yet.

android.title: Android phone or tablet
android.step2: If Android asks, allow installing from this source (it asks once).
android.step3: Press Install, then open Karins jigsaw.
android.note: The app is not from Google Play, so Android may warn you. That is expected: choose to install anyway.

windows.title: Windows computer
windows.step2: If Windows says it protected your PC, press More info and then Run anyway.
windows.step3: Open Karins jigsaw from the Start menu.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad
ios.step1: Open this page in Safari (not inside another app).
ios.step2: Press the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.step3: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen.
ios.step4: Press Add. The Karins jigsaw icon is now on your home screen.
ios.note: On an iPhone or iPad only Safari can add a website to the home screen.

browser.title: Install from the browser (Chrome and Edge)
browser.chrome: Chrome: press the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the menu (three dots) and choose Install Karins jigsaw (on Android: Install app).
browser.edge: Edge: press the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the menu (three dots) and choose Apps, then Install this site as an app.
browser.note: The menus differ a little between versions. Look for Install.

share.title: Tell others
share.text: Share this page with friends who would like the app.
